comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a shock absorber; pr-1868 connects and locks a hose quick-coupler.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a recessed tool, counterholding, collar tuning, and iterative cycling. pr-1868 retracts and holds a sprung sleeve, aligns and inserts a tethered fitting, releases the sleeve to engage a pawl, and lets go.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two non-bottoming controlled impacts and a locked setting resistant to witness torque. pr-1868 requires physical pawl engagement, seated geometry, collar return, stillness, release clearance, and in later versions a 10 N pull test.
comparison.reason: Although both manipulate a collar and verify retention, pr-1868’s collar is a binary insertion latch; the candidate’s collar sets a continuous damping parameter whose adequacy is judged by dynamic response.
